title: Real or phishing?
notice: TRAINING SAMPLES — NOT REAL MESSAGES. All brands are fictional and all links are defused.

questions.message:
From: Globex IT Helpdesk <helpdesk@globex-secure-alerts.example.com>
Subject: URGENT!! Password expires in 2 hours

Dear User, verify now or lose your mailbox: https://example.com/login
questions.explanation: Look-alike sender domain, generic greeting, extreme urgency and a threat. Go to the login page yourself and report the message.

questions.message:
From: Globex Facilities <facilities@globex.example.com>
Subject: Fire drill on Thursday 10:30

Hi all, the building fire drill is on Thursday at 10:30. Please use the nearest stairwell. No action needed online.
questions.explanation: Internal domain, expected topic, no link, no request for credentials or money. Not every message is a trap.

questions.message:
From: Dana Whitfield <accounts@vandelay-supplies.example.com>
Reply-To: dana.billing@example.net
Subject: RE: Invoice 4471

Our bank details changed. Please pay the new account in the attached Invoice_4471.pdf.html and keep this confidential.
questions.explanation: Bank-detail change, Reply-To mismatch, secrecy, and a double extension (.pdf.html). Verify by phone using a number already on file.

questions.message: SwiftPost: your parcel could not be delivered. Pay a $1.99 redelivery fee within 24h: https://example.com/swiftpost-fee
questions.explanation: Small fee plus deadline is a card-theft hook. Check tracking on the carrier's official site or app.

questions.message: At 11:42 pm your phone shows "Approve sign-in to Globex Mail?" for the fourth time. You did not try to sign in. A text then arrives from "Globex IT" asking you to reply with the 6-digit code to stop the alerts.
questions.explanation: A prompt you did not start means someone has your password. Tap Deny, then reset your password and report it.

questions.message:
From: Initech Payroll <payroll@initech.example.com>
Subject: Your October payslip is available

Your payslip is ready in the HR portal. Open the portal from your intranet bookmark. We never send payslips as attachments.
questions.explanation: Expected, no link to click, points you to a bookmark and states a clear policy. Telling you where NOT to expect things is a good sign.

questions.message:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan.ceo@example.net>
Subject: Are you at your desk?

I'm in a meeting and need a quick, discreet favour. Reply ASAP. Sent from my mobile.
questions.explanation: Executive name on an outside address, secrecy, urgency. Next step is usually gift cards. Verify through a known channel.

questions.message: A caller says: "I'm from IT. We detected malware on your laptop. Please install this remote support tool so I can fix it, and don't mention it to colleagues."
questions.explanation: Unsolicited IT call, remote access request, and secrecy. Hang up and call the official helpdesk number.

questions.message:
From: Globex Security <security@globex.example.com>
Subject: Reminder: annual awareness training

Please complete the annual training from the Learning page on the intranet before the end of the month. We will never ask for your password.
questions.explanation: Internal sender, no link, routes you to a known location. It tells you what the company never does.

questions.message:
From: DocuBox via Jordan Lee <share@docubox-mail.example.org>
Subject: Jordan shared "Q4 Salary Review.xlsx"

Open document: https://example.com/docubox/view. Sign in with your email provider.
questions.explanation: Tempting title, off-brand sender domain, and a sign-in request. Check with Jordan another way.

questions.message: A flyer taped in the lobby: "Free coffee for staff! Scan to claim" with a QR code and no company name.
questions.explanation: Anyone can post a QR code. You cannot read the destination before scanning; if you do, preview the URL. Report it to facilities or security.

questions.message:
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@initech-partners.example.net>
Subject: Slides from the Lisbon panel

Great meeting you last week! Slides: https://example.com/shared/panel-slides. Could you sign the attached contract by tonight?
questions.explanation: Tailored to you, new contact, file link plus a same-day signature request. Verify the person and use approved sharing tools.
